bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
r=/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot
sha=1d97db6d00e47d92ca769e541b5dfe3f1299dee4
branch=fix/room-production-public-sync-20261113
w="$r/.worktrees/room-public-sync-1d97db6"
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 70
git -C "$r" fetch -q origin "$branch" || exit 71
test "$(git -C "$r" rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" = "$sha" || exit 72
if test -d "$w"; then test "$(git -C "$w" rev-parse HEAD)" = "$sha" || exit 73; else git -C "$r" worktree add --detach "$w" "$sha" >/dev/null || exit 74; fi
docker compose -p deploy -f "$w/deploy/gserver-compose.yaml" --project-directory "$r/deploy" config -q || exit 75
docker inspect deploy-gaybbs-1 --format 'BOT_RUNNING={{.State.Running}} BOT_IMAGE_ID={{.Image}}'
docker inspect deploy-postgres-1 --format 'DB_RUNNING={{.State.Running}}'
echo DEPLOY_COMPOSE_SOURCE_SHA="$sha"
echo ROOT_COMPOSE_HASH=$(sha256sum "$r/deploy/gserver-compose.yaml" | cut -d' ' -f1)
echo STAGED_COMPOSE_HASH=$(sha256sum "$w/deploy/gserver-compose.yaml" | cut -d' ' -f1)
docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -X -U gace -d gaybbs -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -At -F '|' -c "SELECT e.kind,r.status,COUNT(*) FROM room_source_events e JOIN room_posts r ON r.room_id=e.room_id WHERE e.state='pending' GROUP BY e.kind,r.status ORDER BY e.kind,r.status" || exit 76
docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -X -U gace -d gaybbs -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -At -F '|' -c "SELECT COUNT(*) AS sent_room_deliveries,COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE d.rendered_text IS NULL) AS missing_original,COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE d.inline_buttons IS NULL) AS missing_buttons FROM posting_deliveries d JOIN announcement_posts a ON a.announcement_id::text=d.source_id WHERE d.source_type='announcement' AND a.room_id IS NOT NULL AND d.status='sent' AND d.telegram_message_id IS NOT NULL" || exit 77
echo ROOM_PUBLIC_SYNC_PREFLIGHT_PASS
